about_the_game:
We play as Niki, a police woman, who discovers that there are several entities that cursed the world and all its inhabitants, invoking the end of the world in only 15 minutes! After this time lapse, everything will reset until 15 minutes before the world is destroyed.

As Niki, you will need to fight hordes of cute but dangerous monsters and big badass bosses! You have the key to save the world from destruction, and only you have the skills and strength to be able to survive the time-loop as many times as you need.

Also, you will be able to upgrade your skills and stats, and some missions during the loop will allow you to add more time before the world explodes!

Complete missions, extend the time to complete your ultimate goal, meet wonderful NPCs and live the full fledge action in this awesome shooter!

Featuring:

  • Action roguelike mechanics

  • Upgradable skills tree Lots and lots of guns

  • Cute (but deadly) enemies

  • Plenty of humor!

  • Compelling story involving time-loops

  • Open world divided by thematic zones

  • Japanese culture and anime references

  • Lots of missions, NPCs and collectables
